summary: Medical and health services manager with over 9 years of progressive experience overseeing clinical and administrative operations in mid-size regional health care settings. Skilled in staff supervision, fiscal operations, and implementing record management systems that improve resource utilization and regulatory compliance.

experience.title: Health Services Manager
experience.employer: a mid-size regional health care organization
bullets: Direct, supervise, and evaluate work activities of 45 nursing, technical, clerical, and service personnel across two outpatient departments.
Implemented a computerized record management system to store and process personnel and patient activity data, reducing report generation time by 30%.
Plan and administer clinical programs and services, coordinating medical, nursing, and physical plant staff to maintain continuous operations.
Manage fiscal operations including budget planning, authorizing expenditures, establishing service rates, and coordinating monthly financial reporting.
Monitor use of diagnostic services, inpatient beds, facilities, and staff to assess needs for additional resources and reallocate staffing accordingly.

experience.title: Practice Operations Manager
bullets: Directed recruitment, hiring, and training for clinical and administrative staff, filling 20 positions within budget targets.
Established work schedules and assignments for staff based on workload, space, and equipment availability, improving appointment utilization by 18%.
Maintained awareness of advances in medicine, diagnostic equipment, data processing technology, and health insurance changes to guide operational decisions.
Conducted fiscal operations including accounting, budget planning, expenditure authorization, and coordination of financial reporting for three clinic sites.
Developed and maintained computerized record management systems to produce staffing and productivity reports for leadership.

experience.title: Assistant Health Services Administrator
bullets: Supervised and evaluated work activities of nursing, technical, and clerical personnel, conducting performance reviews and corrective action plans.
Planned, implemented, and administered personnel administration and training programs in coordination with medical and nursing leadership.
Monitored use of diagnostic services, inpatient beds, facilities, and staff to ensure effective resource use and identify equipment needs.
Assisted with fiscal operations including accounting, budget planning, and authorizing expenditures for departmental supplies and services.
Maintained awareness of government regulations and health insurance changes to support compliance and financing options.

experience.title: Administrative Coordinator
bullets: Coordinated work activities of clerical and service personnel supporting medical, nursing, and physical plant departments.
Developed and maintained computerized record management systems to store and process personnel activities and generate operational reports.
Established work schedules and assignments for staff according to workload, space, and equipment availability.
Supported recruitment, hiring, and training of personnel and maintained training documentation for compliance reviews.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Health Services Management
